preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(line.split()[0]) and N >= 1 and N <= 5000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after T is an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 5000) representing the number of cities to visit.

preconditions.expression: all(len(cities) == N - 1 for cities in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+N] for i in range(1, T+1, N)])
preconditions.description: Each test case contains exactly N-1 lines of city connections (cards).
Each card line is of the form 'A B C' where A and B are city names and C is the cost.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The cost C for each card is an integer between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) >= 1 and len(B) >= 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for A, B, C in [line.split()[:3]])
preconditions.description: City names A and B in each card have lengths between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(A != B for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for A, B, C in [line.split()[:3]])
preconditions.description: No card connects a city to itself (A ≠ B).

preconditions.expression: all(A.isalpha() and B.isalpha() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for A, B, C in [line.split()[:3]])
preconditions.description: City names A and B contain only alphabetic characters (case-sensitive).

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == N + 1 for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[i+1][0]) for i in range(0, T)] for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[j:j+N+1] for j in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), N+1)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output contains exactly N+1 lines: N-1 lines for the ordered cards and 1 line for the total cost.

postconditions.expression: all(all(line in stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+N] for line in output_lines[:N-1]) for i in range(1, T+1, N) for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[i][0])] for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[j:j+N+1] for j in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), N+1)])
postconditions.description: The first N-1 lines of each test case's output are the same cards as the input, but in the correct order.

postconditions.expression: all(all(output_lines[k].split()[0] == output_lines[k+1].split()[1] for k in range(N-2)) for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[i][0])] for i in range(1, T+1, N) for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[j:j+N+1] for j in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), N+1)])
postconditions.description: The output cards form a valid path where the destination city of one card is the origin city of the next card (A_i.B_i = A_{i+1}).

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[N-1] == str(sum(int(line.split()[2]) for line in output_lines[:N-1])) for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[i][0])] for i in range(1, T+1, N) for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[j:j+N+1] for j in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), N+1)])
postconditions.description: The last line of each test case's output is the total cost of the journey, which is the sum of the costs of the ordered cards.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(city for line in output_lines[:N-1] for city in line.split()[:2])) == N for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[i][0])] for i in range(1, T+1, N) for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[j:j+N+1] for j in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), N+1)])
postconditions.description: The output path visits exactly N distinct cities (no city is visited more than once).
